bear_assumptions: USD 3.50 normalized EPS at 12x as lithium pricing normalizes sharply, capex and state take constrain owner returns, and Australian conversion contributes little.
base_assumptions: USD 5.50 normalized EPS at 14x as volume remains healthy but realized prices settle below the Q2 run-rate and capex absorbs part of cash generation.
bull_assumptions: USD 7.50 normalized EPS at 16x as storage demand, price discipline, project execution and iodine support durable above-mid-cycle earnings.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger primary evidence on normalized lithium prices, volume, state take, partnership attribution, capex, minority interests, debt and owner cash conversion clears expected-return, base-return, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade if realized pricing, demand, permits, project execution, partnership economics or balance-sheet resilience deteriorates.
